## Visualizing Dynamics with Manim

This section contains Python scripts using the **Manim** engine (developed by Grant Sanderson of 3Blue1Brown) to animate mathematical physics theorems.

### Available Animations

1. **`pendulum_scene.py`**: Animates the simple and double pendulum phase space and motion.
2. **`brachistochrone_scene.py`**: Races three balls along a cycloid, straight line, and parabola to visually demonstrate the Euler-Lagrange time optimization.
3. **`kepler_precession.py`**: Visualizes orbital precession under non-inverse-square perturbations ($V(r) \sim -1/r^{1+\epsilon}$).

To render a scene locally:
```bash
manim -pql manim/pendulum_scene.py DoublePendulumScene
```
